title: Henry M NDE 20315
content:
I was cleaning the undercarriage of a car and it fell off the jack stand. It fell on me and the pinch weld hit my head and knocked me out. I was aware of the car falling then I felt a bump, like a mall rock hitting my head and then I got up. It was like colors were more than colors. It looked like I could touch them, it felt like the air was silk sheets moving over my body. I felt like I was being watched, and I looked around and saw no one. I then turned around and saw my head bleeding. Then I felt like I was falling and then I was back in my body. My wife soon after, came out screaming for the amount of blood coming out of my head. She drove me to the hospital where I had a minor skull fracture, and I needed six stitches. Other than that I was fine.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death A car fell of a jack onto me.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I didn't see myself. But I would assume I was in my body form because I stood up.
elements.At what time during the experience were: It was just as if I knew what was going on all around me.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning It seemed like time stopped, but yet it was still moving just past my arm's length.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: The air seemed to have the sound of sheets moving over your ears.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I was still in my driveway; I saw my house, the front, side, and back yard. I did not see any other people/creatures there.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain There wasn't a light, but colors and the day light seemed to be alive, or moving in a way.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It was like I had two sets of eyes, and that sound was coming from all directions. Everything seemed to feel cooler, softer.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I honestly felt like you feel after a good cry.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I now believe we can have an OBE.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The worst part was when I saw myself and felt like I was falling. When I awoke I felt let down, very dirty.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes There reactions were 'Wow ' And no, they were not influenced in any way by my experience.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes Sometimes when I sleep, I feel that I'm falling, then I wake up just like I did when I had the accident.
